answer: At each epoch, a randomly chosen committee votes on a rotating lantern holder who broadcasts a signed signal from a fixed knoll, proving liveness. Each agent must stake tokens and burn a small fee to register, with reputation tied to that stake. Faking identities means paying the stake and fee per node, and sybils that fail the knoll signal lose their stake, so mass fake accounts become economically irrational. In practice, sa0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
